scripts.build: bun run --cwd codemirror-gad build && bun run --cwd prism-gad build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd codemirror-gad typecheck && bun run --cwd prism-gad typecheck
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd codemirror-gad clean && bun run --cwd prism-gad clean
scripts.publish:dry: cd codemirror-gad && bun publish --dry-run && cd ../prism-gad && bun publish --dry-run
scripts.publish: cd codemirror-gad && bun publish && cd ../prism-gad && bun publish
